key.name: style-apps
key.description: Write a colour file for libadwaita apps to ~/.config/gtk-4.0/mist.css and import it from gtk.css. Both are removed when Isobar is turned off.

key.name: follow-scheme
key.description: Set GNOME's light/dark preference from the brightness of the wallpaper when the wallpaper changes.

key.name: swap-icons
key.description: If the icon theme is Papirus, switch between Papirus-Light and Papirus-Dark with the light/dark preference. Other icon themes are left alone.

key.name: swap-cursor
key.summary: Switch the DMZ pointer light and dark
key.description: If the cursor theme is DMZ, switch between DMZ-Black and DMZ-White with the light/dark preference. Other cursor themes are left alone.

key.name: startup-colour
key.description: Keep the colour the shell paints while it starts at the wallpaper's average colour. Needs Ubuntu's com.ubuntu.login-screen schema.

key.name: terminal-accent
key.description: Write the current accent colour to ~/.cache/isobar/accent so a terminal logo can use it.
